title: Reopenings, Planogram Work and the Share of Settlement Credited for a Lapse
content:
Approved resumption requests on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the trailing year bring a share of the settlement into a lapsed funding credit, and the planogram work approved over the same year settles how large that share is.

## Conditions and shares

**The high lapse share of 6 per cent of the settlement** is credited as well where the agreement carries at or above 1 approved resumption request over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out, and at or above 2 approved planogram changes over those twelve months.

**The low lapse share of 3 per cent of the settlement** is credited where the agreement carries at or above 1 approved resumption request over those twelve months, and below 2 approved planogram changes over them.

**Where the agreement carries no approved resumption request over those twelve months**, no share of the settlement is credited for the lapse.

## The boundaries

The repeat resumption count is 1 approved resumption request over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 1 meets it, and none does not. The planogram floor is 2 approved planogram changes over those same twelve months: exactly 2 is at or above it, and 1 is below it.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying 2 approved resumption requests and 3 approved planogram changes over the trailing year, against a settlement of 1920.00 USD, is credited a further 115.20 USD. With a single approved planogram change over that year, it would be credited 57.60 USD.
